purpose: One-time read-only snapshot of account subscription plan, state and listed price for Cloud Paper zero-cost review.

execution.history_check: One Actions workflow-runs metadata request; prior or ambiguous runs fail closed.

allowed_operations: One read-only Cloudflare account subscription request.
Secret-free report artifact and Actions summary.
forbidden_operations: Invoice, payment method, billing profile or member access.
Any create, update, delete, purchase, plan change, or subscription mutation.
D1 SQL, D1 provisioning/migrations, R2 object access, provider requests, or market data.
Training, holdout access, strategy promotion, trading, or schedule activation.
Retries, pagination, additional Cloudflare calls, or reruns.
